test_title: PYST 67: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following situations represents balanced force?

options.text: A ball falling freely under gravity.
A moving car comes to rest when brakes are applied.
Two people push a box from opposite sides with equal force.
A person riding a bicycle uphill.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Two people push a box from opposite sides with equal force**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Balanced forces** occur when the **resultant force** or **net force** acting on an object is **zero**. This means the forces acting from all directions cancel each other out perfectly.
 
• In the case of **two people pushing a box from opposite sides with equal force**, the forces are **equal in magnitude** but **opposite in direction**. Because they act along the same line, they neutralize each other, resulting in no change in the box's state of motion. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
 
• When a **ball is falling freely under gravity**, the only significant force acting on it (ignoring air resistance) is the **force of gravity**. Since there is no upward force to balance it, the ball undergoes **acceleration** at a rate of approximately **9.8 m/s²**. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
